title: AIA Excluding Individual IHH Consultants From Panel On ‘Purely Commercial’ Basis: IHH
snippet:
KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 15 — Private hospital operator IHH Healthcare Malaysia has objected to the exclusion of some of its consultant doctors from insurer AIA Malaysia’s panel on purported “commercial” grounds.

IHH, one of the country’s largest private health care providers, operates 18 hospitals in Malaysia.

The IHH Healthcare Malaysia CEO’s letter also indicated that the exclusion of some of the hospital group’s consultant doctors from AIA’s panel was made on a numerical basis.
